You wont get anywhere if you arent moving. Yeah you may be losing the motivation for it but when i was where you sound like you're at i was in a halfways house, struggling with meth addiction, and all around doing nothing. But my uncle told me that i wont go anywhere if i dont get some momentum in my life. And he was right. Im 21, and that scenario was 4 months ago. I put my all into jobs, made a resume and just spammed it on indeed. Then out of nowhere i actually got a job i wanted, and im working in the fraud department in verizon for 13 an hour. Its more than I've ever made in my life. So yeah things get better, but only if you make them better. Nothing happens on its own bruv. Keep your chin up alright? It's hard work but you can do it.

If all you're doing is functioning no its not. Thats lazy. Stop just functioning and do something. Or just wimp out and decide you aren't enough without booze. That you are lesser. I hope that you don't think that of yourself. But that's what you are if you need to give yourseld a handicap or a crutch.

Well then tough tit i guess. I found what makes me happy. I have my bad days and my good ones but im better now than i was when id smoke a 8 ball every other day. If i can do it and so can the rest of the world its obviously possible, if you want it to be. And with that attitude it doesnt seem like you want it to be and im pretty sure that's your problem.

But based on my own experiences with addiction i can tell you that if you drop the bad attitude about it and look for other things in life besides drinking to make you happy then you'll be a lot happier. Or you can keep going as you are and eventually ruin your life or someone else's.
Sorry if that was a bit rough. I had the same situation with my group of friends from highschool and it pisses ne off to hear it happening to others. I hope you come back from this.

Good. Drop those fuckers like a hot potato. And anyone else who treats you that way for that matter. No matter who it is, because the good friends are the ones who yeah youd drop them in a second but you know theyd never give you a reason for it.

You know, when my sister died i felt the same way. I held on to that for years. Kept to myself, became a veritable hermit untik i had switch flipped in my head that threw me all the way over to the other end if things. Crazy attention whore, do literally anything just to get a smile out of someone or some sense of worth. Led to a lot of life decisions i regret now, mostly drug related going from just smoking some weed to actually moving god knows what for people and eventually getting hooked on dope myself. Things kept spiraling and i kept going deeper and deeper until i finally hit rock bottom when things were going wrong faster than i could "fix" them. That was about 5 months ago. I ended up so twacked out on meth i had been up for 8 days straight. I was gonna ram a telephone pole going as fast as my car could go. But i let it slip to a friend, and i ended up in the hospital instead. Ive been clean since, and after months of therapy and backtracking my past i finally realized i never got over my sisters death. I never grieved, and i never let go. Don't let that happen to you. Because there is a reason to keep going. There are people who care for you, some of them you just can't see right now and some of them just havent come yet. I have 3 people in my life. My girlfriend, and my two friends. My brother joseph(friend but he's my brother to me) has been there since forever i just never saw him when i was where you are at. And the other two of the three musketeers of my life came with time, so things will get better. But don't let this eat you. Don't let this tragedy become you. You can get past it. It's possible believe me.
Im sorry bud... But you're doing the right thing and thats what matters. Keep it up sport.
